title: The chore coat
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
logline: Wednesday. Wood buys a chore coat at the thrift store. Oversized. Canvas. Pockets you can put your whole hands in. The strip doesn't say what the pockets are for. Saturday will.

panels.composition: The thrift store. WOOD holding up a canvas chore coat, two sizes too big. BARNABY at the hem.

image.prompt: brush-pen over blue pencil, harsh xerox grain, stark black spotting, rain in frantic vertical hatching, a young man holding up an oversized canvas chore coat in a cluttered thrift store, a small dog sniffing its hem

panels.composition: The pockets. Deep. Wood's hands going in to the wrist.

image.prompt: brush-pen over blue pencil, harsh xerox grain, stark black spotting, rain in frantic vertical hatching, close-up of a young man's hands pushed deep into the pockets of a canvas chore coat

panels.composition: In the mirror. The coat to the knee. The strip draws it exactly; it will draw it for twenty-seven years.

image.prompt: brush-pen over blue pencil, harsh xerox grain, stark black spotting, rain in frantic vertical hatching, a thin young man in an oversized knee-length canvas chore coat reflected in a thrift-store mirror
image.notes: The chore coat (characters.md wood_20 → wood_44). Draw it right the first time.

panels.composition: Walking out in it, in the rain. Hands in the pockets. The dog. The coat's collar up.

image.prompt: brush-pen over blue pencil, harsh xerox grain, stark black spotting, rain in frantic vertical hatching, a young man walking out of a shop into vertical rain in an oversized chore coat with his hands deep in the pockets and collar up, a small dog beside him, no words

notes: The chore coat, bought. Hands in the pockets to the wrist.
